name: Mild Beef Chili with Mushrooms, Butternut Squash & Pickled Veggies (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small butternut squash
340 g white mushrooms
1 red bell pepper
2 stick celery
½ bunch radish

instructions.primary_message: Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and small dice the flesh. Place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the butternut squash and set aside.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a small bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and halve onion; small dice half and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Reserve remaining onion for later use.)
Once the pot is hot, add bell pepper, celery, onion, beef, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp chili powder
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp nutmeg, ground
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is done, add butternut squash, mushrooms, tomatoes, and broth to the pot. Stir to combine the chili and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer until squash is tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (411 g) can diced tomatoes
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, and salt in the reserved bowl. Stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Slice remaining onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside to pickle.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 2 ½ cups of chili, a ⅓-cup of sour cream, and a ½-cup of cheese between bowls. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining chili, sour cream, cheese, and pickled veggies between bowls. Drizzle with hot sauce and enjoy
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup sour cream
1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
1 ½ tbsp hot sauce
